        "The complete owned test diff makes both selected panel and browser existence explicit.         "Comments name the final snapshot and guards use early returns with separated logical steps. No Spaces UI, tab navigation or intermittent failure test was run.",
        "Full Bug2002870 and D275097, including all nine actual inline bodies, distinguish a loaded document from the expected document. The author keeps dual URL access only during the pre-check, then checks contentWindow.location.href after completion; the exact source adopts that separation and Assert.stringMatches. The reviewer’s initial getElementById suggestion is corrected when the numbered prefix is explained; a new class is suggested but the landed selector still matches the prefix. Redundant type/string-presence checks are removed. Separate failed and successful historical diff builds do not establish new execution."

        "The complete owned diff replaces the raw new pointer with RefPtr<MimePgpeData>, removes its obsolete allocation-null check, transfers ownership with forget().take() on both nonzero closure returns, and adds NS_IF_RELEASE in MimePgpe_free.",
        "MimePgpeData implements nsISupports. During initialization, zero-closure returns after an error now leave the local RefPtr to release its retained object; a nonzero closure owns the transferred reference. The proxy-creation-failure branch still returns a data closure, and other consumer behavior on that path is not redesigned here.",
        "The actual MIME class registers init/write/eof/generate/free callbacks. Its parse-begin stores the returned closure, and finalizing cleanup invokes crypto_free then resets the tagged closure. Free removes the proxy callback and clears its reference before releasing data. This is the checked handoff chain, not a proof that every parser path or cycle is leak-free.",
        "Exact original-to-accepted comparison for this file has only a later unused Preferences include/using removal. The selected initialization/free behavior remains. Existing field-type/default analysis is already published and is not duplicated as a new null-style rule.",
        "No test or assertion changes. No encrypted message, allocator/leak checker or crypto runtime was executed.",
        "Complete Bug2004034 and D275227 retain the LeakSanitizer failure and the author’s initial not-leaking report, immediately narrowed to this initialization point with separate suspected Botan/rnp leaks. The exact ownership transfer supports the local fix; it does not establish whole-process leak freedom. The linked Try log and native encrypted-message paths were not executed or opened here."
